steps.where: Agent resources › Object Store › Bucket browser
steps.do: Create the bucket policy-corpus (new-bucket field, +), open it, New folder policies, open the folder and Upload the eleven policy documents (not the READMEs).
steps.see: Eleven rows policies/<name>.md; the preview of data-retention-policy.md shows the retention table with Security audit logs.

steps.where: Agent resources › Knowledge Bases › New knowledge base
steps.do: Create new, bucket policy-corpus, tick the policies folder, name it, and under Advanced configuration choose Markdown Aware, MiniLM L6 v2, chunk size 1400, overlap 120. Create knowledge base.
steps.see: A KBR-… run goes queued, then completed; the header switcher reads v1 (active).

steps.do: Open Explore › Chunks; search 365 days; open the source filter.
steps.see: data-retention-policy.md · chunk … in the results, all 11 documents in the source filter, Chunk count 27 in the Version Summary.

steps.do: Ask the same question in Dense, Hybrid and GraphRAG.
fill: How long are security audit logs retained?
steps.see: Citations reading [1] <file>.md and, under Retrieved chunks, a chunk containing 365 days, in every mode.

steps.where: Prompt lifecycle › Prompts › New prompt › Calibration
steps.do: Create the prompt kb-answer (paste the body of kb-answer.md), open its Calibration stage and upload calibration-questions.jsonl under Upload calibration dataset as policy-qa-calibration.
steps.see: Uploaded 41 examples to policy-qa-calibration. and the set appears under Test Sets.

steps.do: Run Dense, top-k 1, Set baseline, then run Hybrid, top-k 1.
steps.see: Recall@k 88% and nDCG@k 90% (Faithfulness and Answer correctness — on the simulated stack, the judges need a model; with a real provider they are percentages, e.g. 96% and 71%); after Hybrid, Recall@k 93% and Vs. baseline +5% on Recall@k and nDCG@k.

steps.where: Knowledge Bases › policy-qa-kb › Build › New version
steps.do: New version, tick the policies folder, Advanced configuration: Markdown Aware, MiniLM, chunk size 500, overlap 60.
steps.see: A second run completes and the switcher shows v2 (active): a finished build activates itself.

steps.do: Choose v1 and click Set active; then v2 and Set active again.
steps.see: v1 (active), then v2 (active). The rollback route has no button; Set active on the earlier version is the UI's rollback.

steps.do: Install Grounded Knowledge Assistant: Install, name it, acknowledge the prerequisite, confirm.
steps.see: The Workflow Studio opens on a paused draft with a Knowledge Query node, a Confidence node and an Output.

steps.do: Select the knowledge node, set Knowledge base to policy-qa-kb and Top-K 3, Save, Validate; from the workflow page click Resume, then Open editor › Run Monitor, enter the question and Run.
fill: How long are security audit logs retained?
steps.see: Valid.; run completed; the Output holds [1] data-retention-policy.md and 365 days.

steps.where: Operate › Observability, then Operate › Review Queues
steps.do: Copy the newest trace's id from the address bar (?trace=tr-…). + New Queue policy-qa-review with the question decision_justified; open it, paste the trace id into Trace ids, Enqueue, answer Pass, Submit review.
steps.see: The item is completed and reads Reviewed by admin · wrote 1 assessment(s) back to the trace.
